function.name: GET_ANGLE
function.abstract: Calculate the angle of the line between two processes

description.p: This function returns the angle formed by the line which divides the center of the current process and crosses by the center of the process whose identifier is a parameter.

The habitual use of this function consists of doing that a process "aims" in the direction of another one: it is the typical case of monsters and other objects that they always look for to catch the player.

So that this function returns an useful result, you must check that you have not assigned different values of and the coordinates of both represent the same zone (for example, they must not be each one in a area of different scroll).
